key: CAIN: There's something else going on here, but I can't quite place it.
en: CAIN: There's something else going on here, but I can't quite place it.
ja: カイン: 何か他にも起きてる気がするんだけど、うまく言えねえな。

key: CAIN: Hey, do you really think Gardevoir could have hated Radomus all along?
en: CAIN: Hey, do you really think Gardevoir could have hated Radomus all along?
ja: カイン: なあ、サーナイトってずっとラドマスのこと嫌ってたと、本当に思うか?

key: RADOMUS: Are you quite through with this charade?
en: RADOMUS: Are you quite through with this charade?
ja: ラドマス: この茶番は、もう終わりにしないかね?

key: RADOMUS: It seems they were able to open that door with the power of the Amethyst Pendant.
en: RADOMUS: It seems they were able to open that door with the power of the Amethyst Pendant.
ja: ラドマス: どうやら、アメジストのペンダントの力で、あのドアを開けたようだね。

key: If I heard correctly, do you not also, \PN, possess the Ruby Ring?
en: If I heard correctly, do you not also, \PN, possess the Ruby Ring?
ja: 聞いた話が正しければ、\PN、君もルビーのゆびわを持っているのではないかね?

key: In that case, perhaps we can access a different door.
en: In that case, perhaps we can access a different door.
ja: それなら、また別のドアを開けられるかもしれない。

key: RADOMUS: Ah, so it worked.
en: RADOMUS: Ah, so it worked.
ja: ラドマス: ああ、うまくいったな。

key: I'll follow your lead.
en: I'll follow your lead.
ja: 君についていこう。

key: CAIN: El, what did you do to Gardevoir?!
en: CAIN: El, what did you do to Gardevoir?!
ja: カイン: エル、サーナイトに何をしたんだ?!

key: EL: Please do not defile this holy place with your unintelligible shouting.
en: EL: Please do not defile this holy place with your unintelligible shouting.
ja: エル: この聖なる場所を、理解しがたい叫び声でけがさないでいただきたい。

key: GARDEVOIR: El has done nothing to me.
en: GARDEVOIR: El has done nothing to me.
ja: サーナイト: エルは、わたくしに何もしていませんわ。

key: He has only freed me.
en: He has only freed me.
ja: ただ、わたくしを自由にしてくれただけ。

key: Why is this so hard for you to believe?
en: Why is this so hard for you to believe?
ja: どうしてそれが、そんなに信じがたいんですの?

key: EL: These heretics would not so much as believe in the Lord Arceus even if it bestowed holy Judgment right before them.
en: EL: These heretics would not so much as believe in the Lord Arceus even if it bestowed holy Judgment right before them.
ja: エル: この異端者どもは、聖なる裁きを目の前で下されようとも、アルセウス様を信じようとはしないのだろう。

key: Their minds are made up already based on fictions they heard prior.
en: Their minds are made up already based on fictions they heard prior.
ja: 奴らの心は、以前に聞いた作り話によって、すでに固まってしまっている。

key: One cannot see truth without first questioning their eyes.
en: One cannot see truth without first questioning their eyes.
ja: まず自らの目を疑わなければ、真実は見えないものだ。

key: Come, Gardevoir, and Adrienn.
en: Come, Gardevoir, and Adrienn.
ja: さあ、サーナイト、それにアドリエンヌも。

key: Let us ascend.
en: Let us ascend.
ja: 昇ろうではないか。

key: CAIN: This is getting weird...
en: CAIN: This is getting weird...
ja: カイン: これ、だんだんおかしくなってきたな……

key: ADRIENN: It is strange.
en: ADRIENN: It is strange.
ja: アドリエンヌ: おかしいわね。

key: When I fell down here, I was certain I would be trapped and alone.
en: When I fell down here, I was certain I would be trapped and alone.
ja: ここに落ちてきた時は、閉じ込められて一人きりになると確信していたのに。

key: But almost immediately, I saw a girl climbing up the cave wall, and then El and Gardevoir appeared...
en: But almost immediately, I saw a girl climbing up the cave wall, and then El and Gardevoir appeared...
ja: でもほとんどすぐに、洞窟の壁を登っている少女を見かけて、それからエルとサーナイトが現れて……

key: And now you all.
en: And now you all.
ja: それで今度は、君たち。

key: Is this some kind of secret tourist spot?
en: Is this some kind of secret tourist spot?
ja: ここって、何かの秘密の観光名所なのかしら?

key: RADOMUS: If so, I'm displeased with their customer service.
en: RADOMUS: If so, I'm displeased with their customer service.
ja: ラドマス: もしそうなら、その接客態度には不満だな。

key: CAIN: Well, that is not at all what I meant, but, uh, okay?
en: CAIN: Well, that is not at all what I meant, but, uh, okay?
ja: カイン: いや、全然そういう意味じゃなかったけど、まあ、いいか?

key: If I heard correctly, do you, \PN, not also possess the Ruby Ring?
en: If I heard correctly, do you, \PN, not also possess the Ruby Ring?
ja: 聞いた話が正しければ、\PN、君もルビーのゆびわを持っているのではないかね?

key: In that case, perhaps we can access a different door...
en: In that case, perhaps we can access a different door...
ja: それなら、また別のドアを開けられるかもしれない……

key: But almost immediately, I saw a girl climbing up the cave wall, and then El and Gardevoir appeared.
en: But almost immediately, I saw a girl climbing up the cave wall, and then El and Gardevoir appeared.
ja: でもほとんどすぐに、洞窟の壁を登っている少女を見かけて、それからエルとサーナイトが現れたの。

key: LIN: First, understand, \PN,
en: LIN: First, understand, \PN,
ja: リン: まず、わかってほしいんだけど、\PN、

key: Mine is the power of a God.
en: Mine is the power of a God.
ja: あたしの持つ力は、神のもの。

key: But not just any God--
en: But not just any God--
ja: でも、どんな神でもいいわけじゃない――

key: Mine is but a child.
en: Mine is but a child.
ja: あたしのは、まだ子供の神。

key: As it has grown, so have I.
en: As it has grown, so have I.
ja: それが成長するにつれて、あたしも成長した。

key: But none grow fast enough to protect themselves.
en: But none grow fast enough to protect themselves.
ja: でも、自分自身を守れるほど早く成長できる者なんて、いない。

key: Not even when they need it most.
en: Not even when they need it most.
ja: それが一番必要な時でさえ。
